record_title: Euclidean tangent obstructions for complex-order spherical maximal operators on rank-one spaces
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Necessary conditions only. The p>2 result narrows but does not close the gap to known sufficient bounds. For 1<p<=2 only the non-strict complex boundary is obtained, with no endpoint claim. No statement is made for p=infinity, weak endpoints, lacunary maximal operators, or higher-rank symmetric spaces. The tangent-space mechanism is classical in spirit; originality is claimed only for its application to the newly introduced all-rank-one complex-order family and the resulting necessary region. The source preprint is very recent, so contemporaneous unindexed coverage remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
